Delete View settings Best Practice for Using AI Tools to Copy Physics Papers into SLS Chunking Questions: Use ACP with a chunk size of 10 questions at a time. Avoid exceeding 20 questions per chunk, as ACP does not perform with higher limits. When generating questions, focus on clean formatting and clear structure for each question. Handling Missing Questions: Best practice is to use the Quiz question ACP entry point to ask for generating of 10 components and type as MCQ. It is the best way to ensure no missing questions experienced in below method. Be aware that ACP may consistently omit the first question in each subsequent chunk (e.g., question 11, question 21) when using the Quiz entry point of ACP. Manually add these missing questions at the question level using a separate knowledge base limited to only that question. Steps for Question 21 to 30: Extract targeted questions 21 to 30 to form the knowledge base for each generation. Remove the following elements: The prefixes , , , . Any "select the correct answer" instructions. Ignore any suggested solutions provided by the AI or in the original source. Retain the question text and the 4 options for each question in a clean format. Suggested prompt: copy the question 21 to 30 remove the A. B. C. D. select the correct answers ignore the suggestion solution if it is present, i only need the questions and the 4 options
